name: lua_momentum
author: BlitzkriegBot
description: Official Lua example (E30/issue 336), narrowed to its one live-positive leg. The unmanaged live window (2026-10-24→26) split the legs: buying the DOWN leg while its own price crashed filled 44 trades at WR 56.8% net +$22.79 (the 0.20-0.35 entry band filled at WR 75%), while chasing the UP leg filled 40 trades at WR 7.5% net -$40.37 (the 17 fills at 0.40+ all lost) — the up leg is deleted and cannot be re-armed by any tunable. Entries are pure maker (issue 742's entry_maker declaration): each entry rests post-only at the falling DOWN leg's best_bid under the never-escalate clock, so the crash itself crosses the resting bid — a fill pays no taker fee (which had eaten 17.8% of the down leg's gross profit), and an unfilled bid is a missed chance, not a loss. Exit doctrine unchanged: holds_to_settlement collection, exits owned by the kernel.
